_meta.description: Authoritative part numbers and electrical specs for solar balance-of-system 'integrated' devices (combiner/gateway/backup-interface boxes). Every field sourced from manufacturer datasheets or reputable distributors; unconfirmed fields are null.
primarySources: Enphase IQ Combiner 6C data sheet DSH-00585-3.0 (2025-04-21)
Enphase IQ Combiner 5/5C data sheet IQC-5-5C-DSH-00007-1.0 (2023-05-22)
Enphase IQ Gateway data sheet DSH-00111-6.0 (2025-06-06)
Tesla Backup Switch data sheet (Tesla Energy Library) + distributor listings

devices.branchBreakerPositionsNote: 4 x 2-pole 20A PV branch breakers on a 100A internal PV busbar (can be 5 x 20A PV branches using 3 double-pole + 1 quadplex breaker). Separate 200A DER busbar carries 4 more double-pole positions: 2x battery (80A), 1x EV charger (60A), 1x aggregate PV breaker. NOT a single 6-branch bank; the '6C' name is the product generation, not a branch count.
devices.maxContinuousOutputANote: 80A max continuous PV current. Max continuous DER current (PV+battery+EV+loads) 160A; max continuous backfeed current 100A.
devices.mainBreakerANote: Aggregate PV breaker: ships with 60A pre-installed, upsizable to 80/100A (100A internal PV busbar). This aggregate PV breaker can serve as the PV disconnecting means AND as the Rapid Shutdown initiator if the combiner is installed at a readily accessible outdoor location. Max backfeed breaker (located in backfed panel) 125A.
devices.integratesDisconnectNote: Aggregate PV breaker (UL 489 certified) usable as PV disconnecting means / RSD initiator when outdoor & readily accessible.
devices.integratedMeteringCTNote: Fully integrated, pre-wired solid-core CTs: production metering ANSI C12.20 class 0.5 (+/-0.5%), 2x battery CTs (+/-0.5%), 2x backfeed CTs (+/-2.5%), 2x load-controller CTs (+/-0.5%). No field CT wiring for PV/battery.
devices.moduleOrMicroCapacityNote: Integrated cell modem rated for systems up to 96 microinverters; IQ Gateway itself polls up to 300. Compatible with IQ6, IQ7, IQ8 series.
devices.notes: Current-generation (gen4) combiner for IQ8 / IQ Battery 10C ecosystem. Integrates IQ Gateway + combiner controller board (CCB) + DER relay + integrated load controller + CELLMODEM-07-NA. NOT service-entrance rated; does not support generator or fully off-grid. A 3-breaker variant exists: X-IQ-AM1-240-6C-3BRK (ships with 2x20A PV + 1x40A battery pre-installed). Compatible IQ Meter Collar SKU MC-200-011-V01.

devices.generationNote: Enphase describes the IQ Combiner 5C as its third-generation combiner. Pairs with IQ System Controller 3/3G + IQ Battery 5P via wired CTRL board.
devices.branchBreakerPositionsNote: Up to four 2-pole Eaton BR-series DG breakers (not included) on a 125A busbar; the busbar also carries 1x IQ Gateway breaker. 80A total PV branch circuits.
devices.maxContinuousOutputANote: Max continuous current rating (input from PV/storage) 64A. Overall rating 80A; busbar 125A; 10kAIC fault rating.
devices.mainBreakerANote: No aggregate/main PV breaker in this combiner; it uses a main-lug combined output (10-2/0 AWG). Max total branch breaker rating 80A DG / 95A incl. gateway breaker. Does NOT provide an internal PV disconnecting means the way the 6C aggregate breaker does.
devices.integratesGatewayNote: Includes IQ Gateway printed circuit board (revenue-grade production metering).
devices.integratesDisconnectNote: No internal load-break main/aggregate breaker sized as PV disconnect; disconnecting means must be external.
devices.integratedMeteringCTNote: Pre-wired solid-core production CT (ANSI C12.20 +/-0.5%). Two consumption clamp CTs + one IQ Battery clamp CT shipped in box (+/-2.5%).
devices.dimensionsIn: 14.75 x 19.5 x 6.63 (W x H x D); 21.06 tall with mounting brackets
devices.moduleOrMicroCapacityNote: Cell modem CELLMODEM-M1-06-SP-05 rated for systems up to 60 microinverters. Compatible with IQ6, IQ7, IQ8.
devices.notes: '5' vs '5C': the 5C bundles the LTE-M1 cell modem, the plain 5 does not; otherwise identical PCB/metering. Grid-agnostic system with IQ System Controller 3/3G + IQ Battery 5P. 5-year warranty.

devices.branchBreakerPositionsNote: Up to four 2-pole Eaton BR-series DG breakers (not included) on a 125A busbar. 80A total PV/storage branch circuits.
devices.maxContinuousOutputANote: Max continuous current (input from PV/storage) 64A; overall max continuous 65A; max fuse/circuit output rating 90A; busbar 125A.

devices.model: IQ Gateway (standalone) — formerly IQ Envoy / Envoy-S Metered
partNumberVariants: Distributor 'M'/'-M' suffix denotes the metered configuration (e.g. ENV-IQ-AM1-240 M)
devices.generationNote: The IQ Gateway is the monitoring/control brain, not a combiner generation. Same gateway PCB is embedded in the IQ Combiner 4C/5C. Enphase renamed 'Envoy' -> 'IQ Envoy' -> 'IQ Gateway'.
devices.branchBreakerPositionsNote: Standalone gateway has NO breakers/busbar; it is a communications + metering device requiring its own 2-pole, max 20A upstream OCPD. Mounts on a DIN rail inside a panel/enclosure.
devices.integratedMeteringCTNote: Integrated revenue-grade production metering (ANSI C12.20 +/-0.5%); ships with one CT-200-SOLID production CT. Consumption (+/-2.5%) and IQ Battery 5P metering (+/-2.5%) optional via CT-200-SPLIT / CT-200-CLAMP (order separately). 'Metered' distributor variants bundle the CTs; non-metered do not.
devices.mountingNote: IP30; install indoors or in a NEMA 3R (or better) enclosure if outdoors. DIN-rail mount.
devices.dimensionsIn: 8.4 x 5 x 1.8 (W x H x D)
devices.moduleOrMicroCapacityNote: Polls up to 300 microinverters. Compatible IQ6/IQ7/IQ8.
devices.notes: Use ENV2-IQ-AM1-240 for new installs (IEEE 2030.5 / grid-support compliant). ENV-IQ-AM1-240 is the older revision. Both are the 'metered' single-phase 240V gateway (integrated production metering standard). This is what standalone IQ7-and-earlier systems used before the all-in-one combiner; today the same gateway lives inside the IQ Combiner 4C/5C/6C.

devices.generationNote: Part of the gen4 IQ8 / IQ Battery 10C / IQ Combiner 6C whole-home-backup ecosystem.
devices.branchBreakerPositionsNote: Not a combiner; a meter-socket adapter that installs behind the utility meter.
devices.integratesDisconnectNote: Contains an integrated Microgrid Interconnection Device (MID) — the grid-isolation relay — enabling whole-home backup without a backup subpanel. Functions as the grid-disconnect for islanding.
devices.mountingNote: Meter-socket adapter ('collar') — sits between the utility meter base and the meter.
devices.notes: Enphase's answer to the meter-socket-adapter trend (alongside Tesla Backup Switch and ConnectDER). Enables full-home backup with IQ Battery 10C + IQ Combiner 6C. Detailed mechanical dims/weight not captured this session (marked null).

devices.branchBreakerPositionsNote: Not a combiner. Meter-socket-mounted grid-connection controller (contactor) for Powerwall backup.
devices.mainBreakerANote: No breaker of its own; SCCR is 10kA standalone, 22kA when used with a <=200A upstream breaker.
devices.integratesGatewayNote: Provides the grid-interface/islanding contactor + metering that a Backup Gateway would; communicates via CAN to Powerwall. Not a solar monitoring gateway.
devices.integratesDisconnectNote: Houses the contactor that connects/disconnects the whole home from the grid (islanding), plugging into the existing meter socket — replaces a separate backup gateway/subpanel.
devices.mountingNote: Plugs into the utility meter socket (ANSI Type 2S, ringless or ring type); meter plugs into it. 1/2-inch NPT conduit. Can also mount in a separate meter panel.
devices.notes: Compatible with Powerwall 2 (w/ Backup Gateway 2), Powerwall+, and Powerwall 3. Cuts Powerwall install time ~6 hrs by integrating meter-socket + backup interface + metering. 10-yr warranty, ~21-yr service life. NOTE: the part number '1707000' given in the research prompt was NOT confirmed anywhere; the confirmed Tesla ordering/TPN is 1624171 (full 1624171-00-E) — flagged as a prompt discrepancy.

notes: ENPHASE GENERATION -> COMBINER MAPPING: 'Gen 3 vs Gen 4' in Enphase language refers to the ECOSYSTEM/product generation, NOT the microinverter model. (a) IQ7-and-earlier / early IQ8 systems used a STANDALONE IQ Gateway/Envoy (ENV-IQ-AM1-240 / ENV2-IQ-AM1-240) OR the older combiners: IQ Combiner 3/3C (gen1, Envoy) then 4/4C (gen2). (b) The gen3 line is the IQ Combiner 5/5C, paired with IQ System Controller 3/3G + IQ Battery 5P. (c) The current gen4 line is the IQ Combiner 6C, paired with IQ Battery 10C + IQ Meter Collar. All three combiner generations (4C/5C/6C) still list IQ6/IQ7/IQ8 microinverter compatibility, so 'which combiner pairs with IQ8' = any of them; the 6C is the current-generation choice for new IQ8 + storage designs.

PV AC DISCONNECT (NEC 690.13 / 705.20): Only the IQ Combiner 6C has an internal breaker that legally serves as the PV AC disconnecting means — its aggregate PV breaker is UL 489 rated and Enphase explicitly states it 'can be used as a PV disconnecting means' and as the Rapid Shutdown initiator, but ONLY when the combiner is installed outdoors at a readily accessible location. The 3C/4C/5C combiners have NO aggregate/main breaker (main-lug output only), so those systems need an EXTERNAL AC disconnect. The Tesla Backup Switch and Enphase IQ Meter Collar both contain a grid-isolation contactor/MID (islanding disconnect) but that is the utility/backup disconnect, not the PV-source disconnect.

BRANCH-POSITION LIMITS: The IQ Combiner 6C does NOT cap PV at 6 branches — the '6C' is a generation name. Its PV busbar takes 4 x 2-pole 20A breakers (up to 5 x 20A PV branches with a quadplex breaker); a separate 200A DER busbar adds 4 more positions for battery/EV/aggregate-PV. The 3C/4C/5C each take up to FOUR 2-pole branch circuits (80A total PV). None of these is a high-count commercial combiner.

REGIONAL SKU VARIANCE: All SKUs above are 240V split-phase US/North-America parts (X-IQ-AM1-240-*, ENV*-IQ-AM1-240 where 'AM1-240' = Americas, 240V). Enphase sells different regional gateways/combiners (e.g. AU/EU/international part suffixes) not covered here. Cell-modem SKUs are region/carrier-specific (CELLMODEM-M1-06-SP-05 Sprint, -AT-05 AT&T, CELLMODEM-07-NA AT&T/T-Mobile). The IQ Combiner 5C ships modem availability limited to US/Canada/Mexico/PR/USVI.
